message: The other day, I was chatting with my neighbor about smoke alarms, and I casually mentioned how important it is to test them regularly. Fast forward to a few hours later when she called me to say hers went off while she was cooking. Turns out, she hadn't checked it in ages! I couldn't help but smile a bit and say, "I told you so!" It’s always good to keep those alarms in check, folks. Anyone else have a similar moment?
